# Up next (`up-next`)

The queue after the current track or episode: art, titles, play now and remove.

Group: Home controls. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/home';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createUpNext` (types in `dist/web/home/media-voice/upNext.d.ts`): `.mh-up-next`: the queue after what is playing, as a labelled group with an ordered `__list` of `__item`s: the 1:1 `__art` (lazy `__image` or `__placeholder` icon; `.is-empty`), `__text` (`__title`, `__subtitle`), the `__duration`, and `__play` / `__remove` buttons named after the item. A `__more` line counts what `max` leaves out. When an item goes away while focus is in it, the focus moves to the same button of the item now in its place (or the one before), so a keyboard user can remove several in a row.

```ts
export function createUpNext(options: UpNextOptions): UpNextHandle;

export interface UpNextOptions extends UpNextData, UpNextEvents {}

export interface UpNextHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  update(options: UpNextOptions): void;
}

export interface UpNextData {
  items: readonly UpNextItem[];
  /** Show at most this many, with "N more" after them. */
  max?: number;
  /** Accessible name (default "Up next"). */
  label?: string;
  labels?: Partial<UpNextLabels>;
}

export interface UpNextEvents {
  onPlay?: (id: string) => void;
  /** Without it there is no remove button. */
  onRemove?: (id: string) => void;
}

/** One thing in the queue: a track, an episode. */
export interface UpNextItem {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  /** Artist, show, album. */
  subtitle?: string | null;
  /** Artwork URL; a themed placeholder when missing or failing. */
  art?: string | null;
  /** Placeholder icon (default a music note; `film` suits episodes). */
  icon?: IconName | string;
  /** Seconds. */
  duration?: number | null;
}

/** Every word the queue shows or speaks. `{title}` is the item's title, `{count}` a number. */
export interface UpNextLabels {
  group: string;
  empty: string;
  play: string;
  remove: string;
  more: string;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createUpNext, type UpNextEvents, type UpNextItem } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

let items: UpNextItem[] = [
  { id: 'q1', title: 'Harbour Lights', subtitle: 'The Low Hills', art: '/art/up-next-1.jpg', duration: 214 },
  { id: 'q2', title: 'Slow Rivers', subtitle: 'Ines Okafor-Lund', art: '/art/up-next-2.jpg', duration: 187 },
  { id: 'q3', title: 'A Map of Quiet Places', subtitle: 'Cinder Vale Quartet', duration: 301 },
];

const drop = (id: string): void => {
  items = items.filter((i) => i.id !== id);
  queue.update({ items, ...events });
};

const events: UpNextEvents = {
  onPlay: (id) => {
    void fetch('/player/play', { method: 'POST', body: id });
    drop(id);
  },
  onRemove: drop,
};

const queue = createUpNext({ items, ...events });

document.body.append(queue.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { UpNext } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { UpNextItem } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

export function UpNextExample() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<UpNextItem[]>([
    { id: 'q1', title: 'Harbour Lights', subtitle: 'The Low Hills', art: '/art/up-next-1.jpg', duration: 214 },
    { id: 'q2', title: 'Slow Rivers', subtitle: 'Ines Okafor-Lund', art: '/art/up-next-2.jpg', duration: 187 },
    { id: 'q3', title: 'A Map of Quiet Places', subtitle: 'Cinder Vale Quartet', duration: 301 },
  ]);
  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState('Lanterns Over the Quay');
  const drop = (id: string) => setItems((list) => list.filter((i) => i.id !== id));
  const play = (id: string) => {
    setPlaying(items.find((i) => i.id === id)?.title ?? playing);
    drop(id);
  };
  return (
    <>
      <p>Now playing: {playing}</p>
      <UpNext items={items} onPlay={play} onRemove={drop} />
    </>
  );
}
```
